label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: Natural bodies lack cognition
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., quinta via: aliqua quae cognitione carent, scilicet corpora naturalia
interpretation: The scilicet names natural bodies as things lacking cognition; only 'every natural body lacks cognition' is formalized, not the converse. Animals have sense cognition and are not natural bodies in this sense; the argument as formalized concerns natural bodies only.
